newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Michael Hill forecasts record yr profit.
newsitem.headline: Michael Hill forecasts record yr profit.

text.p: Michael Hill International Ltd said on Friday its first quarter revenue and earnings were ahead of last year and it was confident of a record profit in the coming year.
"The first three months trading of the new financial year, which is traditionally the lightest trading period of the year, has been very satisfactory," chairman Michael Hill said.
"Total revenue is up 11 percent on last year and after tax profit is comfortably up on last year and ahead of budget," he told shareholders at the annual meeting.
"However, it must be emphasised that our major trading period is still ahead of us in the November - January period," he said.
The company plans to open up to eight new stores in the next year, depending on whether it can get the right sites in Australia and New Zealand.
"We continue to consolidate the improve the earnings from our existing stores and remain confident of another record tax paid profit in this coming year," he said.
Hill said one the few threats was excessive rental increases from shopping mall owners.
